name: Office Suite
description: Read, write and convert Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, extract text from scanned documents, and draft documents in your organisation's house style.

needs.prompt: API token for the Office cloud service
Locale for template descriptions, e.g. en-GB

capabilities.name: Extract document text
capabilities.description: Read a .docx and return its text with heading structure preserved.

capabilities.name: Write document
capabilities.description: Create or update a .docx from Markdown, keeping the template's styles.

capabilities.name: Query spreadsheet
capabilities.description: Run a SQL-like query over a sheet and return matching rows.

capabilities.name: Convert to PDF
capabilities.description: Convert a document to PDF, preferring the installed office application for exact fidelity.

capabilities.name: Scanned document OCR
capabilities.description: Vision model that turns scans and photographed pages into text.

capabilities.name: Template gallery
capabilities.description: Browsable catalogue of letter, report and deck templates.

capabilities.name: House style tokens
capabilities.description: Fonts, colours and margins the house style expects.

capabilities.name: Office Formatting
capabilities.description: How to structure and format a document, spreadsheet or deck so it survives review.

capabilities.name: Meeting minutes
capabilities.description: Turn a raw transcript into minutes with decisions and owners pulled out.

capabilities.name: House style
capabilities.description: Starter house-style conventions — voice, date format, terminology — to edit for your organisation.

capabilities.name: Document reviewer
capabilities.description: Reviews a draft against the house style and returns findings only.

capabilities.name: Monthly report
capabilities.description: Collect the month's spreadsheets, build the report and export it to PDF.

capabilities.name: Spreadsheet preview
capabilities.description: Renders a sheet as a sortable table in a side panel.
